I have farmed this land for many years and I know it well. This plot is only 0.07 hectares, so buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer is too expensive and too much for this small piece; I will put chicken manure and compost instead. I will plant cassava stems I kept from last season, not buy new seed, and I will not waste money on chemicals or irrigation because the rains here are steady. My family and I will work this plot for about 12 days this season, and I will not hire any outside labor because cash is tight.
